title: Valuation question! Why did NSE cut its IPO size and price below unlisted market levels?
summary: NSE MD and CEO Ashish Chauhan said the exchange had invited shareholders to tender shares before filing the draft red herring prospectus. He said bankers advised the exchange on pricing, while the IPO size was based on the shares tendered by shareholders on the day of the updated draft red herring prospectus.

title: Former NY Fed President on Remembering 9/11

Dudley said the plane was unable to land in the U.S. and was sent to Saint John’s, Newfoundland, where passengers were kept for six days. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Tyler Kendall on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
